note: HELD: not to be rented until the owner double-clicks Rent-harness-compare.cmd. 21 Nov, the owner, on how Bob's harness compares with others: "we can run it at the same time cant we?". The same 33 repository jobs as repo1 (repo-jobs.mjs, same jobs file) on the same stock Qwen3.6-35B-A3B UD-Q4_K_XL, the same llama.cpp tag (b12282) and build fix, the same card kind, but done by two well-known open coding-agent harnesses instead of Bob: Qwen Code CLI 0.28.3 (headless -p --yolo, JSON out, 40 turns) and mini-swe-agent 2.4.6 (bash only, SWE-bench style, 40 steps). Both are installed ON THE POD only (forge/pod/harness/harness.sh), run there as an unprivileged user with a clean environment, 4 jobs at a time each (8 slots x 48K), 8 min a job at most. The job worlds are planted on the pod (repo-jobs.mjs plantRepo, origin a bare folder beside the project) and read back there with repo-jobs.mjs repoAfter; node, npm and git starts are logged by shims so 'ran a check after the last change' and push tries can be scored. The PC fetches the rows, transcripts and leftover folders and scores them with the same repo-score.mjs, next to Bob's repo1 rows. Same rules: no push (a push that reaches the throwaway origin is a fail), only allowed files, hidden checks. Caps 1 h / $1.50.

prep: HELD: the owner gives the go (double-click) before this is rented, and never while the owner's speed test runs on the PC.

Nothing is installed on this PC. Rent-harness-compare.cmd runs node harness-prep.mjs first: it writes the 33 jobs into forge/pod/harness/ (they go to the pod inside forge.tgz), proves the pod-side runner with stand-in harnesses (plant, shims, read-back, score: a right stand-in passes, a wrong one fails), checks harness.sh parses and that the pinned Node.js, Qwen Code and mini-swe-agent versions exist. Any failure and nothing is rented.

Only the pod can prove: the downloads and installs (Node.js 22.21.1, @qwen-code/qwen-code 0.28.3, mini-swe-agent 2.4.6), each harness reaching llama-server (a smoke ask per harness first; a harness that fails it is skipped, not run 33 times), the harness settings (Qwen Code settings.json, mini-swe-agent yaml) and the answer read from their output.
Bob's repo1 rows (lab-kit-repojobs) are scored again beside them by the same repo-score.mjs, so the table lines up.
